verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a Kimi help-center category listing '记忆' (memory) among its general features, which suggests a memory feature exists but says nothing about how it works. The million-token context claim covers a single session, not memory across chats, so it is not credited. missing for 10: documentation of how memory persists across chats and is applied in new conversations, user controls for viewing/editing/deleting memories, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
